scholarships.title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Technical Degree)
scholarships.provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.award_amount: ₹50,000 per annum for each year of eligible study
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Girl students admitted to the first year of an AICTE-approved technical degree course, or second year through lateral entry, with annual family income not exceeding ₹8 lakh; maximum two girl children per family.

scholarships.title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Technical Diploma)
scholarships.provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.award_amount: ₹50,000 per annum for each year of eligible study
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Girl students admitted to the first year of an AICTE-approved technical diploma course, or second year through lateral entry, with annual family income not exceeding ₹8 lakh; maximum two girl children per family.

scholarships.title: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially Abled Students (Technical Degree)
scholarships.provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.award_amount: ₹50,000 per annum for each year of eligible study
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Students with certified disability of at least 40% pursuing an AICTE-approved technical degree, generally admitted in the first year or second year through lateral entry, with annual family income not exceeding ₹8 lakh.

scholarships.title: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially Abled Students (Technical Diploma)
scholarships.provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.award_amount: ₹50,000 per annum for each year of eligible study
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Students with certified disability of at least 40% pursuing an AICTE-approved technical diploma, generally admitted in the first year or second year through lateral entry, with annual family income not exceeding ₹8 lakh.

scholarships.title: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme (Technical Degree)
scholarships.provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Students in AICTE-approved technical degree programmes who meet the Swanath beneficiary conditions, including orphanhood, parental death due to COVID-19, ward of Armed Forces/Central Paramilitary Forces personnel martyred in action, and categories covered by the updated scheme, with family income not exceeding ₹8 lakh.

scholarships.title: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme (Technical Diploma)
scholarships.provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Students in AICTE-approved technical diploma programmes who meet the Swanath beneficiary conditions, including orphanhood, parental death due to COVID-19, ward of Armed Forces/Central Paramilitary Forces personnel martyred in action, and categories covered by the updated scheme, with family income not exceeding ₹8 lakh.

scholarships.title: PM-USP Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh
scholarships.award_amount: Academic fee up to ₹30,000/year for General Degree, ₹1,25,000/year for Professional/Engineering/Nursing/Pharmacy/Architecture/HMCT, or ₹3,00,000/year for Medical; plus ₹1,00,000/year maintenance allowance
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Students domiciled in Jammu & Kashmir or Ladakh who have passed Class XII/equivalent and satisfy the scheme's admission and income conditions; the scheme supports undergraduate study outside the UTs in eligible institutions.

scholarships.title: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS) — Renewal
scholarships.provider: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
scholarships.award_amount: ₹12,000 per annum at UG level for the first three years; ₹20,000 per annum at PG level / specified later-study years as prescribed by the scheme
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Merit-based scholarship for eligible college and university students meeting the scheme's Class XII merit, institution, income and renewal requirements; the 2026-27 NSP listing currently shows renewal applications open.

scholarships.title: Central Sector Scholarship of Top Class Education for SC Students
scholarships.provider: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
scholarships.award_amount: Full tuition and non-refundable charges subject to notified ceilings; academic allowance ₹86,000 in the first year and ₹41,000 in subsequent years under the published scheme pattern
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Meritorious SC students admitted to notified Top Class institutions and eligible courses, subject to the notified family-income ceiling and institutional/course conditions.

scholarships.title: Scholarship for Top Class Education for Students with Disabilities
scholarships.provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
scholarships.award_amount: Financial support covering eligible tuition and notified academic/living components under the Top Class Education for Students with Disabilities scheme
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Students with benchmark disability pursuing higher education in eligible institutions/courses under the notified Top Class scheme, subject to the family-income ceiling and disability certification requirements.

scholarships.title: Post Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
scholarships.provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
scholarships.award_amount: Maintenance, compulsory non-refundable fees and other allowances as prescribed under the disability scholarship guidelines
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Students with benchmark disability pursuing post-matric education, subject to disability certification, course/institution eligibility and the notified annual family-income ceiling.

scholarships.title: Financial Assistance for Education to the Wards of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM — Post Matric
scholarships.award_amount: Education assistance as per notified class/course slab under the Labour Welfare Fund scholarship scheme
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Children/wards of eligible Beedi, Cine, IOMC or LSDM workers pursuing post-matric education, subject to the scheme's worker-status, course and family-income conditions.

scholarships.title: Financial Assistance for Education to the Wards of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM — Pre Matric
scholarships.award_amount: Education assistance as per notified pre-matric class slab under the Labour Welfare Fund scholarship scheme
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Children/wards of eligible Beedi, Cine, IOMC or LSDM workers studying at pre-matric level and satisfying the worker-status, course and family-income conditions.

scholarships.title: National Means Cum Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
scholarships.provider: Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education
scholarships.award_amount: ₹12,000 per annum from Class IX through Class XII
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Selected students from eligible government, government-aided and local-body schools who qualify under the NMMSS merit and means requirements and continue their studies through the covered classes.

scholarships.title: National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students — Scholarship
scholarships.award_amount: Financial support for higher education including notified scholarship components under the National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students scheme
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Eligible ST students admitted to notified higher-education programmes and institutions under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs scheme, subject to income and other notified eligibility requirements.

category_specific_proof: Visa/I-20 or equivalent for overseas study

terms_and_conditions.margin_money: Nil up to ₹4 lakh; 5% for higher domestic-study amount; 15% for study abroad under CGFSEL

loans.government_subsidy_details: Eligible beneficiaries may qualify for PMAY-U 2.0 Interest Subsidy Scheme: 4% subsidy on the first ₹8 lakh for up to 12 years, subject to household income up to ₹9 lakh, eligible home-loan amount up to ₹25 lakh and property value up to ₹35 lakh.

terms_and_conditions.moratorium_period: Up to 36 months, depending on construction stage
terms_and_conditions.co_applicant_required: Depends on borrower profile and sanction conditions
terms_and_conditions.margin_money: 10% for loans up to ₹30 lakh; 20% for ₹30–75 lakh; 25% above ₹75 lakh

loans.interest_rate_range: 7.60% - 11.30% p.a. floating; fixed-rate option from 8.50% to 11.20% for new cars

terms_and_conditions.moratorium_period: No general moratorium published for standard car loans

terms_and_conditions.margin_money: Varies by scheme, borrower profile and vehicle; bank-specific margin conditions apply
